executive_summary: Analysis of lab CMS server identified a critical Apache HTTP Server vulnerability (CVE-2021-26691) involving a heap overflow via mod_session.

findings.title: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.25 Heap Overflow
findings.label: urgent

fired_rules.text: IF cvss is critical AND epss is high THEN priority is urgent

findings.remediation: Upgrade the Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.47 or later, where the heap overflow vulnerability involving mod_session and crafted SessionHeader values has been corrected. Replace or update vulnerable modules and ensure unbounded memory operations are properly mitigated. Sources: MITRE CWE (CWE-787: Out-of-bounds Write, CWE-119: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer).
